import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load dataset
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert 'is_takeaway' to categorical
coffee_sales['is_takeaway'] = coffee_sales['is_takeaway'].astype('category')

# Create a barplot to compare the total sales for takeaway and dine-in
takeaway_sales = coffee_sales[coffee_sales['is_takeaway'] == 1]['total'].sum()
dine_in_sales = coffee_sales[coffee_sales['is_takeaway'] == 0]['total'].sum()

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.barplot(x=['Takeaway', 'Dine-in'], y=[takeaway_sales, dine_in_sales])
plt.title('Total Sales for Takeaway and Dine-in')
plt.xlabel('Order Type')
plt.ylabel('Total Sales')
plt.legend(title='Order Type')
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the plot to a file
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
